meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for United Arab Emirates merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (FCSC) institutional core
reports.description: Primary federal statistical office responsible for national accounts, prices, demographic, social and multi-domain statistics, and coordination with emirate-level statistical centres.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the UAE federal statistical system.
reports._cadence_evidence: fcsc.gov.ae is a dataset portal: subjects are catalogued with coverage ranges (Annual National Accounts 2010-2025, CPI 2008-2025, Births 1976-2024, Air Transport 2014-2025, Climate January 2016-December 2024) rather than as issues. The site publishes no release calendar; the only schedule statement is that data 'will be updated following the official release of the review results' of the ongoing GDP review.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Population estimates
reports.description: Official population estimates. Population is approximately 10 million; the structure includes a large majority of non-nationals and high urban concentration in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

_variants.description: Official population estimates for the UAE, reflecting the large non-national component of the resident population.

reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~10 million; expatriate-majority structure.
reports._url_evidence: FCSC page titled 'Population Estimates - FCSC - Federal Competitiveness And Statistics Center', the official UAE population estimates series page.
reports._cadence_evidence: fcsc.gov.ae/uae/population-2/ renders only as a titled landing page ('Population Estimates') plus text about the RASMI data-accreditation initiative. No population documents, no coverage years and no release frequency appear on the page.
reports._variants_reviewed: 2026-08-18: Adopted the variant cadence (1/yr). The kept record omitted it entirely; the variant states annual. Kept the more specific URL.

reports.title: National Accounts of the UAE (GDP)
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP). The economy combines hydrocarbon production (concentrated in Abu Dhabi) with a large diversified non-oil services, logistics, tourism and finance base (concentrated in Dubai and other emirates).

_variants.description: Official national accounts estimates of gross domestic product and related aggregates, covering both oil and non-oil activity.
_variants.title: National Accounts (GDP)

reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Dual hydrocarbon + diversified structure.
reports._url_evidence: FCSC statistical document page titled '2010 - 2025 - National Accounts', the official UAE national accounts/GDP series.
reports._cadence_evidence: FCSC's statistics-by-subject listing carries 'Annual National Accounts 2010 - 2025' alongside 'Quarterly National Accounts 2012 - 2026'; the national-accounts document page itself is titled '2010 - 2025, 2010 - 2025 - National Accounts'. The quarterly series is the highest-frequency release, running through 2026.
reports._variants_reviewed: 2026-08-18: reviewed, no change. The kept record was the better of the two — differences were a vaguer title, a publisher abbreviation, a less specific URL, or an identical value.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has generally been moderate under the dirham peg and active demand management.

_variants.description: Official consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a basket of goods and services. Released on a regular cadence and used as the primary domestic inflation measure.
_variants.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)

reports._url_evidence: FCSC page titled 'Prices - CPI' covering annual and monthly consumer price index data 2010-2025.
reports._variants_reviewed: 2026-08-18: reviewed, no change. The kept record was the better of the two — differences were a vaguer title, a publisher abbreviation, a less specific URL, or an identical value.

reports.title: Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, the dirham peg, foreign-exchange reserves management, banking supervision and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, BOP and related series.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to FCSC. Dirham peg is the monetary anchor.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBUAE site lists its reporting stack by frequency: monthly Statistical Bulletin (banking and monetary statistics), monthly 'Monetary & Banking Developments' summary and banking-operations statistics; quarterly 'UAE Monetary, Banking & Financial Markets Developments', Quarterly Economic Review and Credit Sentiment Survey; annual Central Bank Annual Report (2025 report issued April 2026) and Financial Stability Report. Monthly is the governing cadence.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Large current-account surpluses are structural, driven by hydrocarbon and services exports; significant net acquisition of external financial assets is a persistent feature.

_variants.description: Official balance-of-payments statistics compiled according to BPM6, covering the current, capital and financial accounts.
_variants.title: Balance of Payments

reports._notes: External-accounts node under surplus and asset-accumulation structure.
reports._url_evidence: CBUAE Research and Statistics page stating the department 'compiles and distributes statistics related to banking, monetary, insurance and balance of payments'; the UAE National Summary Data Page names this exact URL as the Balance of Payments browse link.
reports._cadence_evidence: The CBUAE research-and-statistics page names balance of payments only as a responsibility of the Data and Statistics Centre ('compiling and distributing statistics related to banking, monetary, insurance and balance of payments'). No BOP editions, reference periods or periodicity are stated; the only frequency wording on the page is for the annual MSME Business Survey Report.
reports._variants_reviewed: 2026-08-18: Adopted the variant cadence (1/yr). The kept record omitted it entirely. Kept the more specific URL.

reports.title: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report (MOMR)
reports.publisher: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
reports.description: Flagship recurring publication of OPEC. Provides assessments of crude oil prices (including the OPEC Reference Basket), world oil demand and supply, non-DoC liquids production, and related market analysis. Continues to be published after the UAE’s May 2026 departure.

reports.title: Crude oil production and export statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from national and energy monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics on crude oil and condensate production and exports. Production is concentrated in Abu Dhabi; export volumes are large and responsive to OPEC+ and market conditions. Hydrocarbons remain a core current-account and fiscal contributor alongside the diversified non-oil base.
reports._notes: Core hydrocarbon production and external-earnings node.
_referenced_by: National accounts and BOP goods account
reports._url_evidence: FCSC statistical document page titled 'Oil and Gas' carrying national oil and gas production data for 2009-2024.
reports._cadence_evidence: The FCSC oil-and-gas document page enumerates single-year editions - 2024, 2023, 2022, 2020 - alongside cumulative series tables (2009-2013, 2009-2015, 2009-2016, 2009-2017, 2009-2018, 2010-2019); FCSC's subject index lists the set as 'Oil and Gas 2009 - 2024'. Coverage years are annual, one edition per year.

reports.title: Labour force and expatriate employment statistics
reports.description: Labour-force and employment statistics by citizenship. The workforce is overwhelmingly non-national; Emiratisation policies and private-sector localisation targets are continuously tracked alongside overall employment and participation.
reports._notes: Core labour-market densification under expatriate-majority structure.
reports._url_evidence: FCSC page titled '2024, 2023, ... 2008 - Labor Force', the official UAE labour force statistics series.
reports._cadence_evidence: The FCSC labour-force document page title enumerates per-year documents: 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016, 2009, 2008; FCSC's subject index lists it as 'Labour Force 2008 - 2024'. One statistical document per reference year.

reports.title: Tourism and visitor-arrival statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from Dubai DET and national sources
reports.description: Statistics on overnight visitor arrivals and tourism performance. Dubai is the dominant destination; multi-million annual arrivals support a large hospitality, retail and transport services base.
reports._notes: Core tourism densification under services-diversification structure.
reports._url_evidence: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism 'Annual Visitor Report 2024' page in DET's official Reports & Resources section.
reports._cadence_evidence: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism page is titled 'Annual Visitor Report 2024' - the word 'Annual' plus a single reference year identifies a yearly edition. No monthly product or other cadence is referenced on the page.

reports.title: Monthly Statistical Bulletin — Banking & Monetary Statistics
reports.description: Monthly compilation of monetary aggregates (M1, M2, M3), central-bank assets and liabilities, gross international reserves, bank deposits, credit and related banking indicators.

reports.title: Labour Force statistics (employed population and labour force by citizenship, gender, age, activity)
reports.description: Official labour-force and employment statistics broken down by citizenship, gender, age group, economic activity and employment status. Captures the large non-national component of the workforce.

reports.title: Education statistics (general and higher education)
reports.description: Official statistics on general education and higher education enrolment and related indicators.

reports.title: Health services statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on health services.

reports.title: CBUAE Base Rate decisions (Overnight Deposit Facility)
reports.description: Policy interest-rate decisions for the Base Rate applicable to the Overnight Deposit Facility. The rate is anchored to the US Federal Reserve’s Interest Rate on Reserve Balances and signals the monetary-policy stance under the dirham peg.

reports.title: Crude oil and condensate production and export statistics
reports.publisher: ADNOC / energy monitoring (compiled from official and industry sources)
reports.description: Statistics on crude oil and condensate production and export volumes. Production is concentrated in Abu Dhabi; export volumes are large and respond to OPEC+ and market conditions. Hydrocarbons remain a core contributor to the current account and fiscal position.
reports._url_evidence: Same FCSC 'Oil and Gas' statistics page (duplicate of ae-oil); ADNOC/SCAD publish no equivalent public oil production statistics page that could be retrieved.

reports.title: Dubai overnight visitor arrivals and tourism performance
reports.publisher: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
reports.description: Official statistics on overnight visitor arrivals to Dubai and related tourism performance indicators (occupancy, source markets). Dubai is the dominant tourism destination within the UAE.

reports.title: Jebel Ali and UAE ports container throughput
reports.description: Container and cargo throughput statistics centred on Jebel Ali Port. The UAE is a major global transshipment and logistics node; throughput is a key indicator of the non-oil trade and logistics economy.

reports.title: UAE–GCC merchandise trade statistics
reports.description: Statistics on merchandise trade between the UAE and other GCC member states. Total trade volume reached AED 333 billion in 2024; re-exports form a large share. Reflects the UAE’s position inside the GCC Customs Union and Common Market.

reports.title: Banking sector total assets, deposits and gross credit
reports.description: Monthly and periodic statistics on total banking-sector assets, resident and non-resident deposits, and gross bank credit by sector. Total assets exceeded AED 5.5 trillion in recent readings.

reports.title: Government Finance Statistics (GFS) — revenues, expenditures, assets and liabilities
reports.description: Official government finance statistics compiled according to the IMF Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014. Covers consolidated revenues, expenditures, assets and liabilities at the national level; quarterly and annual releases.

reports.title: Mubadala Investment Company assets under management and performance
reports.description: Annual reporting of assets under management, capital deployment, proceeds and long-term returns for Mubadala, one of Abu Dhabi’s major sovereign investment vehicles. AUM reached AED 1.4 trillion (US$385 billion) in 2025.

reports.title: Construction sector output and contract awards framing
reports.publisher: Derived from industry and official monitoring sources
reports.description: Framing and statistics on construction sector activity, including output value and contract awards. Construction is a major component of non-oil GDP and is closely linked to real-estate, infrastructure and mega-project activity in both Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
reports._url_evidence: FCSC statistical document page titled 'Construction' covering 2013-2022 construction sector statistics.

reports.title: Major merchandise trade partners statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from trade data compilations and FCSC-related sources
reports.description: Statistics on major export and import partners. China, India, Japan, the United States, Saudi Arabia and others feature prominently; crude petroleum, gold and refined petroleum dominate exports while gold, telephones and cars feature among top imports.
reports._url_evidence: FCSC page titled 'Commodities Trade' with UAE merchandise trade statistics 2000-2025 (annual and 3/6/9-month, general and special systems).

reports.title: Renewable energy capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from IRENA and national energy monitoring
reports.description: Statistics on installed renewable energy capacity. Capacity reached approximately 7.9 GW in 2025, driven primarily by solar PV; the UAE has a longer-term target of 23 GW by 2031.
reports._url_evidence: FCSC statistical document page titled '2024, 2023, ... 2017 - Renewable Energy' with national installed renewable capacity statistics.

reports.title: Biennial Transparency Report / NDC progress reporting
reports.description: Official climate transparency and NDC progress reporting submitted under the UNFCCC framework (Biennial Transparency Report and related common tabular formats).

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

2026-08-19: the 35 records resolved 'continuous-database' were given a nominal releases_per_year (250 business-day portals/feeds/query databases; 365 all-days monitoring: air quality, volcano/seismic, tropical-cyclone, disaster-event feeds), each with a cadence_note naming the convention. Original delivered value untouched in _cadence_original; evidence untouched in _cadence_evidence.

domain_semantic_pass.merged_into_existing: Synonyms folded into the 22 already-approved tags (prices→inflation, employment→labour, demography/census→population, monetary/central-bank→monetary-policy, gdp/grdp/regional-accounts→national-accounts, and so on).

domain_semantic_pass.dropped: Geographic pseudo-tags (regional, provincial, urban, municipal, metropolitan) and batch-meta pseudo-tags (comprehensive, multi-domain, meta, indicators) were removed — geography is already carried by region and jurisdiction_level, and the meta ones describe the batch rather than the report.
